tools.name: status
tools.description: Which Meta models and voices are ready, and the daily budget.

tools.name: wake
tools.description: Wake a piece of furniture by label (e.g. "couch") with its size in metres. Returns the spirit id and persona (or Setup required).

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Say something to a woken spirit; Muse Spark answers in its persona (needs MODEL_API_KEY).

tools.name: say
tools.description: Puppet mode: the spirit speaks your line with MMS-TTS (returns the audio length, not the audio).

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Delete a spirit: persona, memories, sheet and crop.
